notes: Globs use the kit's glob_match: '*' stays within one path segment, '**' crosses segments.
AGENTS.md matters only if a root AGENTS.md is ever tracked; none is (SPEC 20.1). PROJECT_DOCUMENTS/KB/AGENTS_POINTER.md holds the pointer text.
tools/minifly_check/** has no exclusions: INTEGRATION_LOG.md, corpus/, EXPECTED.json, RULES.json and this file are protected too.
append_only covers every KB ledger: FINDINGS, INCIDENTS, USER_DECISIONS, DELIVERY_LEDGER, CONFIRM_LEDGER, REVIEW_DEBT and CANARY_COMMITMENTS (invariant I8).
